column1: # Tier 2 to 5: GitHub issues and PRs in the linux-surface org that could relate to the Surface Pro 9 without naming it.
# tier 2: names the Surface Pro 8 (closest sibling: same IPU6 + OV5693/OV13858/VD55G0 cameras, ITHC touch, SAM KIP keyboard,
#         Slim Pen 2) or Alder Lake / 12th gen.
# tier 3: shared subsystem keywords (ithc, ipu6, ov13858, vd55g0, flex keyboard, slim pen, soc_button_array, pinctrl_tigerlake,
#         hpiosize, interrupt storm, enable_psr, quickspi/intel-thc, secure core, dracut, keyboard backlight, surface_battery,
#         microphone, haptic), kernel repo PRs, iptsd open issues and PRs. Old 2019 to 2022 items are kept only if still open.
# tier 4: Fedora packaging related titles. tier 5: initramfs / luks / tablet mode / s0ix / hibernate titles.
# Same id/kind/state conventions as github-sp9.tsv. Titles truncated to 72 characters. created "-" = not captured (later rows).
